chain_words.nuance: to perceive sound without necessarily paying attention
to pay attention to sound in order to understand it
to pay careful attention to advice or a warning
to give full, focused attention to a speaker
to be so engaged that everything else is forgotten

explanation: These words all describe receiving spoken content, from simply perceiving sound to being completely absorbed by a talk.

usage_notes.difference: 'Hear' means perceiving sound passively; 'listen' means paying deliberate attention to understand what is said.
